title: Front Desk Collection Grid — Insured Plan of Care
content:
The front desk grid for the **Insured Plan of Care** lists, payer program by payer program, which patient cost-sharing amounts are collected at the time of service and which are posted only after the payer's explanation of benefits.

| Payer program | Copay collected at time of service | Deductible estimate collected at time of service | Deductible estimate cap per visit | Coinsurance and deductible posted after the explanation of benefits | Posting period after the explanation of benefits (calendar days) | Cost sharing billable to the patient | Copays per date of service (all plans with the same payer) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Commercial PPO Plan of Care | Yes | No | $0.00 | Yes | 5 | Yes | 1 |
| Commercial High-Deductible Plan of Care | No | Yes | $125.00 | Yes | 5 | Yes | 1 |
| Commercial POS Plan of Care | Yes | No | $0.00 | No | 5 | Yes | 1 |
| Commercial HMO Plan of Care | Yes | No | $0.00 | No | 5 | Yes | 1 |
| Medicare Part B Plan of Care | No | No | $0.00 | Yes | 5 | Yes | 1 |
| Medicare Advantage Plan of Care | Yes | No | $0.00 | No | 5 | Yes | 1 |
| Medicaid Managed Care Plan of Care | No | No | $0.00 | No | 5 | No | 1 |

## Column definitions

- **Copay collected at time of service** — whether the plan's per-visit copay is collected at the time of service.
- **Deductible estimate collected at time of service** — whether an estimate of the remaining deductible is collected at the time of service.
- **Deductible estimate cap per visit** — the maximum deductible estimate collected at the time of service for one visit; $0.00 where no deductible estimate is collected.
- **Posted after the explanation of benefits** — whether coinsurance and deductible responsibility is posted to the patient after the payer's explanation of benefits rather than at the time of service.
- **Posting period** — the calendar days after the explanation of benefits is received within which the patient responsibility it shows is posted.
- **Cost sharing billable** — whether any cost-sharing amount may be billed to the patient at all under the payer program.
- **Copays per date of service** — the maximum number of copays collected for one date of service across all of the patient's plans with the same payer.

## Points read from the grid

- The Commercial High-Deductible Plan of Care is the only program that collects a deductible estimate at the desk, and its cap is $125.00 for one visit.
- The Medicaid Managed Care Plan of Care is the only program on which no cost sharing may be billed to the patient.
- On every program no more than 1 copay is collected for one date of service across the patient's plans with the same payer.
